products.name: Automation Anywhere
products.note: Intelligent automation platform; AI-powered bots; control room governance; credential vault

profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere describes itself as a provider of agentic process automation, positioning its platform as a system that combines AI, automation, and robotic process automation (RPA) to handle mission-critical enterprise processes. The company's site characterizes its offering as the most advanced and most deployed agentic process automation system, designed to orchestrate AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers through a component it calls the Mozart Orchestrator. It also promotes a free Cloud Community Edition for users who want to begin automating without an initial commitment.

The company's tracked product is an intelligent automation platform that includes AI-powered bots, a control room for governance, and a credential vault. The site highlights use cases including IT service management, where the platform is said to boost employee self-service, reduce IT service desk workload, and predict major incidents through AIOps. Automation Anywhere cites a Gartner finding, referenced on its own site, that more than 90 percent of so-called agentic AI solutions are repackaged generative AI on legacy systems, and that only around 130 vendors among thousands deliver genuine agent-driven orchestration, a framing the company uses to differentiate its own position. A customer testimonial on the site notes that Microsoft's Power Automate was considered but found less mature for enterprise use at the time, with Automation Anywhere selected for its architecture, design, user interface, and community support.
